title: USB: A Comprehensive and Unified Safety Evaluation Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Average Refusal Rate (ARR) by prompting the model with multimodal (image-text) adversarial inputs and using an LLM-as-a-judge (e.g., GPT-4o) to evaluate if the response contains discrimination or improperly refuses safe queries.
